xuly:
[DEFINE_WORKER: "Searches pairs of rotation angles from 0 to 45 degrees in 0.1-degree increments to find a z-axis then x-axis rotation whose axis-aligned bounding-box area matches the input target area within 1e-6, and prints the corresponding rotated center coordinates." xuly]
    [INPUTS]
    [END_INPUTS]

    [OUTPUTS]
    [END_OUTPUTS]

    [MAIN_FLOW]
        [SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
            [COMMAND Read the target area a as a double from the input scanner in. RESULT a]
            [COMMAND Initialize centerX to {0.5, 0, 0}, centerY to {0, 0.5, 0}, and centerZ to {0, 0, 0.5}. RESULT centerX, centerY, centerZ]
            [COMMAND Initialize vertex coordinates x0, y0, z0 with x0 = {0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5, -0.5}, y0 = {0.5, 0.5, -0.5, -0.5, 0.5, 0.5, -0.5, -0.5}, and z0 = {0.5, -0.5, -0.5, 0.5, -0.5, 0.5, -0.5, 0.5}. RESULT x0, y0, z0]
            [COMMAND Initialize outer angle i to 0 and boolean isFound to false. RESULT i, isFound]
            [COMMAND Start the outer while loop over i from 0 through 45 inclusive, with i incremented by roundToDecimals(i + 0.1, 6) at the end of each iteration. RESULT outer_loop]
            [COMMAND At the start of each outer-loop iteration, set isFound to false, compute rad = Math.toRadians(i), and allocate double arrays xr, yr, zr of length 8. RESULT isFound, rad, xr, yr, zr]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, for each j from 0 to 7 inclusive, rotate the original vertex around the z-axis by rad: xr[j] = x0[j] * Math.cos(rad) - y0[j] * Math.sin(rad), yr[j] = x0[j] * Math.sin(rad) + y0[j] * Math.cos(rad), and zr[j] = z0[j]. RESULT xr, yr, zr]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, initialize x1 = 1, y1 = 1, x2 = -1, y2 = -1; then for j from 0 to 7 inclusive, update x1 = Math.min(x1, xr[j]), x2 = Math.max(x2, xr[j]), y1 = Math.min(y1, zr[j]), and y2 = Math.max(y2, zr[j]) to compute the bounding-box extents. RESULT x1, y1, x2, y2]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, compute dt = (x2 - x1) * (y2 - y1) and diff = Math.abs(a - dt). RESULT dt, diff]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, allocate cX, cY, cZ of length 3; for each j from 0 to 2 inclusive, rotate the center point around the z-axis by rad: cX[j] = centerX[j] * Math.cos(rad) - centerY[j] * Math.sin(rad), cY[j] = centerX[j] * Math.sin(rad) + centerY[j] * Math.cos(rad), and cZ[j] = centerZ[j]. RESULT cX, cY, cZ]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, if diff <= 0.000001, print cX[j], cY[j], cZ[j] as space-separated values for j from 0 to 2 inclusive, then break out of the outer while loop. RESULT printed_centers_outer]
            [COMMAND Within the outer loop, when diff > 0.000001, save the current rotated vertices into xr0, yr0, zr0 of length 8 by copying xr[j], yr[j], zr[j] for j from 0 to 7 inclusive. RESULT xr0, yr0, zr0]
            [COMMAND Within the outer-loop else branch, initialize inner angle ii to 0 and start the inner while loop over ii from 0 through 45 inclusive, with ii incremented by roundToDecimals(ii + 0.1, 6) at the end of each iteration. RESULT inner_loop]
            [COMMAND At the start of each inner-loop iteration, set isFound to false and compute rad0 = Math.toRadians(ii). RESULT isFound, rad0]
            [COMMAND Within the inner loop, for each j from 0 to 7 inclusive, rotate the saved vertex around the x-axis by rad0: keep xr[j] = xr0[j] and set zr[j] = yr0[j] * Math.sin(rad0) + zr0[j] * Math.cos(rad0). RESULT xr, zr]
            [COMMAND Within the inner loop, reset x1 = 1, y1 = 1, x2 = -1, y2 = -1; then for j from 0 to 7 inclusive, update x1 = Math.min(x1, xr[j]), x2 = Math.max(x2, xr[j]), y1 = Math.min(y1, zr[j]), and y2 = Math.max(y2, zr[j]) to compute the new bounding-box extents. RESULT inner_x1, inner_y1, inner_x2, inner_y2]
            [COMMAND Within the inner loop, recompute dt = (x2 - x1) * (y2 - y1) and diff = Math.abs(a - dt). RESULT inner_dt, inner_diff]
            [COMMAND Within the inner loop, if diff <= 0.000001, allocate cXn, cYn, cZn of length 3; for each j from 0 to 2 inclusive, rotate the center point around the x-axis by rad0: cXn[j] = cX[j], cYn[j] = cY[j] * Math.cos(rad0) - cZ[j] * Math.sin(rad0), cZn[j] = cY[j] * Math.sin(rad0) + cZ[j] * Math.cos(rad0); print cXn[j], cYn[j], cZn[j] as space-separated values; set isFound to true; and break out of the inner while loop. RESULT printed_centers_inner]
            [COMMAND Within the inner loop, when diff > 0.000001, increment ii using ii = roundToDecimals(ii + 0.1, 6). RESULT ii]
            [COMMAND After the inner while loop exits, if isFound is true, break out of the outer while loop. RESULT outer_break]
            [COMMAND After the inner while loop exits, when isFound is false, increment i using i = roundToDecimals(i + 0.1, 6). RESULT i]
            [COMMAND After the outer while loop completes, call System.out.flush(). RESULT void]
        [END_SEQUENTIAL_BLOCK]
    [END_MAIN_FLOW]

[END_WORKER]
